text: Customers can pay with crypto and merchant receives the value as fiat in their Stripe balance
quote: Let your customers pay with crypto that settles as fiat in your Stripe balance.

text: Supports USDC, USDP, and USDG stablecoins across Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Base networks
quote: USDC (Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Base networks), USDP (Ethereum and Solana, US-only), USDG (Ethereum, US-only)

text: Stablecoin payments support full and partial refunds
Can authorize recurring stablecoin withdrawals directly from a customer's crypto wallet
quote: Authorize recurring stablecoin withdrawals from your customers’ crypto wallets.

text: Businesses can receive, hold, and send funds globally as stablecoins in a Stripe Financial Account
quote: Receive, store, and send funds globally with stablecoins in your Stripe Financial Account.

text: Eligible businesses can hold a stablecoin balance even in countries where fiat Treasury isn't available
quote: Eligible businesses can hold a stablecoin balance in the countries where it’s available, including markets where fiat Treasury isn’t available.

text: Can create a virtual or physical card to spend held funds
quote: Create a virtual or physical card to spend funds

text: Platforms and marketplaces can pay out to connected accounts in stablecoins
quote: Pay out in stablecoins to connected accounts from platforms and marketplaces.

text: Connected accounts get a USDC balance immediately after linking a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard
quote: After a user links a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard, they immediately see a new USDC balance on their connected account.

text: Can issue virtual or physical prepaid cards for connected accounts backed by stablecoin balances
quote: Issue virtual or physical prepaid cards for connected accounts, backed by stablecoin balances.

text: Fiat-to-crypto onramp lets customers securely buy/exchange cryptocurrency directly at checkout in your platform or Dapp
quote: The Stripe fiat-to-crypto onramp lets your customers securely purchase and exchange cryptocurrencies directly from your platform or decentralized application (Dapp) at checkout.

text: Stripe-hosted onramp redirects customers to a standalone checkout page
quote: Use the Stripe-hosted onramp to redirect your customer to check out in the standalone page.

text: Embedded onramp lets customers check out directly within your website
quote: Use the Embedded onramp to let your customers check out directly in your website.

text: Embedded components onramp offers a mobile SDK so customers can check out inside your app
quote: Use the Embedded components onramp (mobile SDK) to let your customers check out directly in your application.

text: Stripe acts as merchant of record for onramp transactions, assuming fraud/dispute liability and handling KYC and sanctions screening
quote: Stripe acts as the merchant of record for these onramp transactions and assumes full liability for all fraud and disputes. We also handle all regulatory requirements, know your customer (KYC) verifications, and sanctions screening.

text: Supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol
quote: Stripe also supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol.

text: Minimum stablecoin payment amount is documented as 0.01 USDC
quote: For stablecoin payments, the minimum amount is 0.01 USDC.
